name: pr_create
description: Open or reuse a GitHub PR whose body is exactly one concise ## Summary section, using an issue template's primary field for issue-backed runs when available.

repoPath.description: Local git checkout of the change branch to open a PR from.

title.description: PR title. Falls back to the resolved summary, or 'Automated change', when omitted; truncated to 120 chars.

summary.description: Preferred source text for the PR body's Summary section.

summaryFallback.description: Used for the body's Summary section when 'summary' is not supplied.

body.description: Used for the body's Summary section when neither 'summary' nor 'summaryFallback' is supplied.

issueBody.description: Source issue body; when an issue-template field can be extracted from it, that field is preferred over 'summary' for the PR body.

base.description: Base branch for the PR. Defaults to the repository's default branch when omitted.

head.description: Head branch for the PR. Defaults to the current branch when omitted.

draft.description: Open as a draft PR. Accepts a boolean or a truthy/falsy string.

fill.description: Currently unused by the underlying gh call (body is always explicit), reserved for future use. Accepts a boolean or a truthy/falsy string.

created.description: True when a new PR was opened; false when an existing PR was reused or publication was blocked.

existing.description: True when 'created' is false because a PR already existed for this branch. Absent on a fresh creation.

number.description: PR number; 0 when publication was blocked.

url.description: PR URL; empty string when publication was blocked.

draft.description: Whether the PR is currently a draft.

publicationState.description: 'published' on success/reuse; 'permission_blocked'/'policy_blocked' when the remote rejected the update in a way that will not succeed on retry.

body.description: Canonical one-section PR body that was set. Absent when publication was blocked.

summary.description: Resolved Summary section text. Absent when publication was blocked.

summarySource.description: Provenance of the summary text: 'provided_summary', 'issue_template:<label>', or 'fallback'. Absent when publication was blocked.

issueTemplateFiles.description: Issue template filenames considered when resolving the summary. Absent when publication was blocked.

reason.description: Present only when publicationState is not 'published': explains why publication was blocked.

branch.description: Present only when publicationState is not 'published': the local branch that was retained instead of being published.
